verdict.rationale: OpenAI Agents SDK is an agent-building framework (the client role) — its MCP evidence describes connecting to/consuming existing MCP servers (docs-10, docs-35, docs-25 hosted MCP tool), not exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role exception this axis is out of scope; no evidence of an 'mcp serve' mode or hosted MCP endpoint from the SDK itself.
